subject.title: feat(agents): add description field for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should authorized `agents_list` calls expose the existing operator-authored `agents.list[].description` text to the requesting model as discovery metadata?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it changes the trust boundary from stored configuration metadata to model-visible tool output; that disclosure policy cannot be inferred safely from tests alone.

options.title: Approve bounded discovery metadata
options.body: Accept the authorized-only description output, with documentation making clear that descriptions are model-visible operator metadata and must not contain secrets.

options.title: Keep descriptions out of tool output
options.body: Reject this disclosure boundary and leave `agents_list` limited to the existing identifiers and runtime metadata.

options.title: Design a narrower metadata contract
options.body: Pause this PR while maintainers define an explicitly safe capability-summary field or filtering policy for model-visible agent discovery.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded discovery metadata
recommendation.body: Accept the authorized-only description output, with documentation making clear that descriptions are model-visible operator metadata and must not contain secrets.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged configuration-preservation work is the clearest supplied history connection to the existing description field and its user-data contract.
